title: Device notifier should have an option to only unmount, not  detach as well
line: Disks & Devices now has an Unmount action that unmounts a drive but keeps it attached, so it can be mounted again without replugging it.
explanation: Solid's StorageAccess only had teardown(), which after unmounting always ejects the media or powers the drive off (the fix for HDD damage in bug 270808). The applet's only unmount path, Safely remove, uses it, so an external disk vanishes from the list and needs a replug before it can be mounted again. Solid gains StorageAccess::unmount() with unmountRequested/unmountDone signals (udisks2: plain Filesystem.Unmount; fstab: umount; iokit/win: unsupported), and teardown() on an already unmounted volume now goes straight to eject/power off. The applet adds an Unmount entry to the expanded item for mounted removable volumes, which calls unmount(), does not claim the drive can be safely removed, and the action list now resizes when its rows change.

commits.message:
StorageAccess: add unmount() that keeps the drive attached

teardown() always ejects the media or powers off the drive after
unmounting, so a volume could not be unmounted and mounted again
without replugging it. Add unmount() and its signals for that case.

CCBUG: 293906

applets/devicenotifier: add Unmount action that keeps the drive attached

Safely remove always powers off or ejects the drive, so mounting it
again needs a replug. Add an Unmount action to the expanded item that
only unmounts the volume, and let the action list resize as it changes.

BUG: 293906

media.caption: Master: a mounted USB stick, expanded, only offers Safely remove (unmount + power off) and Open with File Manager.
With the fix: the expanded item also has Unmount.
Master: Safely remove powers the drive off and it disappears from Disks & Devices; mounting it again needs a replug.
With the fix: Mount, then Unmount; the stick stays listed with Mount and Mount and Open, and mounting it again works.
